title: Pip Finds a Treasure
style: Warm cheerful cartoon with soft outlines, golden tones, and friendly rounded characters

start.scene: Pip the golden puppy trotting happily through a sunny garden with a rolled treasure map in his mouth, tall sunflowers on both sides and colorful wildflowers on the green grass.
start.text: Pip the puppy found a treasure map! Where does the trail begin?

a.scene: Pip crouching nose-down in a vegetable garden with the map unrolled on the dirt, paw prints in the soil, red tomato plants on the left, orange pumpkins on the right, and tall sunflowers behind.
a.text: Sniff sniff! The trail leads through the sunflowers. Pip hears a sound...

b.scene: Pip running through a playground park with the map in his mouth, a blue-and-yellow tube slide on the left, an orange swing set and monkey bars behind, a sandbox on the right, and a large green oak tree.
b.text: The map shows the park! Where should Pip look first?

aa.scene: Pip standing excitedly next to a small wooden treasure chest he just dug up from a dirt hole in the sunflower garden, flowers and greenery around.
aa.text: Pip digs up a mysterious little chest! It rattles. Should he...

ab.scene: Pip sitting happily beside a metal watering can with three tiny kittens peeking out, surrounded by tall sunflowers in a warm garden.
ab.text: The sound was three tiny kittens, peeking out of an old watering can! 'Mew! Mew! We're hungry and a little lost.'

choices.label: Dig up the treasure to share 🦴

ba.scene: Pip sliding out of a blue tube slide at the park, a shiny golden ball rolling across the green grass nearby, with an orange swing set and sandbox in the background.
ba.text: Wheee! At the bottom waits a shiny golden ball — the map's treasure! And it's rolling away!

bb.scene: Pip at sunset gazing at a large oak tree with a glowing hollow full of fireflies, the playground slide and swings visible in the warm background.
bb.text: The sun is setting at the old oak. Inside lives a family of glowing fireflies! They swirl around Pip.

end_biscuits.scene: Pip sitting proudly next to an open wooden treasure chest overflowing with golden bone-shaped biscuits in a sunny sunflower garden.
end_biscuits.text: The chest is full of golden biscuits! Best treasure a puppy ever found. The End!

end_share.scene: Pip sharing biscuits from an open treasure chest with kittens, a cat, and a bunny on a checkered picnic blanket among sunflowers and a tea set.
end_share.text: Pip opens the chest and shares the biscuits with everyone. Sharing is the best treasure! The End!

end_kittens.scene: Pip leading three tiny kittens along a path to a cozy wooden house with warm glowing windows at twilight, a basket of blankets nearby.
end_kittens.text: Pip leads the kittens safely home before dark. Three sleepy thank-you mews! The End!

end_ball.scene: Pip leaping high into the air to catch a large golden ball at the park, with a blue slide, trees, and a sandbox behind him.
end_ball.text: Pip catches the golden ball with a super jump! Champion Pip! The End!

end_game.scene: Pip playing with a beagle, a dalmatian, and an orange kitten chasing a golden ball at the park at sunset, with a blue slide and swings behind.
end_game.text: Pip and his friends play until sunset. A treasure of a day! The End!

end_fireflies.scene: Pip trotting along a sparkling golden trail of fireflies through a magical garden with a flower-covered arch, mushrooms, and glowing sunflowers at dusk.
end_fireflies.text: The fireflies lead Pip to a secret glowing garden — right where X marks the spot! Magic! The End!
